rules.title: Justify new packages
rules.text: Before adding a dependency, check maintenance, license, size and whether the standard library already covers it.

rules.title: Commit lockfiles
rules.text: Commit lockfiles and install with the frozen or locked flag in CI.

rules.title: Check licenses
rules.text: Only add dependencies with licenses compatible with the project.

rules.title: Upgrade in small steps
rules.text: Upgrade one major dependency per change and read its migration notes.

rules.title: Audit regularly
rules.text: Run the ecosystem audit tool and do not ignore high severity findings without a recorded reason.

rules.title: Pin toolchain versions
rules.text: Pin runtime and toolchain versions in version files (.nvmrc, .tool-versions, rust-toolchain).

rules.title: Do not copy library code
rules.text: Do not copy third-party code into the repository; depend on it properly.
